{"path":"snake_anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5_01.html","edit_description":"Create a complete, self-contained single-file HTML document (inline <style> and <script>, no external dependencies) implementing a classic Snake game with these exact requirements:

GRID & RENDERING
- Canvas-based board, 30x30 cells (e.g. 20px per cell -> 600x600 canvas), with a score HUD above/beside the canvas.
- Dark, clean styling. Draw snake(s) with distinct colors (Player 1 green, Player 2 blue/orange), food as red circle/square.

MOVEMENT
- Snake moves continuously on a timer tick (e.g. every ~100ms), in one of four directions (up/down/left/right).
- Grows by one segment when eating food; food respawns at a random empty cell (not on any snake).
- Hitting a wall or its own body (or another snake's body) ends the game for that snake. In two-snake modes, the game ends when the snake(s) controlled by... simplest rule: a dead snake stops; the match ends when a human-relevant snake dies (for cpu vs cpu: when both are dead). Head-on collision with the other snake kills both-or-either; keep logic simple and documented in code comments.
- Prevent reversing directly into itself (ignore 180-degree turns; use a queued direction so two quick key presses in one tick are handled).

KEYBOARD CONTROLS
- Player 1 (human, WASD or Arrow keys in single-human mode): W/A/S/D and/or arrow keys.
- Player 2 (human in human vs human): Arrow keys for P2 when two humans, and WASD for P1. Keep mapping clear: in human vs human, P1 = WASD, P2 = Arrow keys.
- In cpu vs human, human uses Arrow keys (or WASD); CPU is the other snake.
- Prevent page scrolling with arrow keys/space (preventDefault).
- Enter/Space or R restarts the game when on the game-over screen; Escape returns to the menu.

CPU AI
- CPU snake automatically searches for food: run BFS (or A*) on the 30x30 grid from its head to the food, treating walls and all snake bodies as obstacles (the tail cell may be treated as free since it moves). Choose the first step of the shortest path. If no path to food exists, pick any safe move that avoids immediate death (prefer the move with the largest reachable area / flood-fill count). Never reverse.

GAME MODES & MENU
- Start menu overlay with title "SNAKE", three selectable modes: "Human vs Human", "CPU vs Human", "CPU vs CPU". Select with Up/Down arrows or number keys 1/2/3, confirm with Enter. Show control hints for each mode.
- Mode-specific snakes: Human vs Human = two human snakes. CPU vs Human = one CPU snake + one human snake. CPU vs CPU = two CPU snakes (auto-run, with speed a bit fast enough to watch).
- In CPU vs CPU, the game ends when both snakes have died.

HUD / SCORE
- Display the score during gameplay for each snake (labels: P1 / P2 or CPU / Human appropriate to the mode), plus the mode name. Update live.

GAME OVER SCREEN
- Overlay showing "GAME OVER", the winner (or draw) and final scores, and "Press ENTER or R to restart, ESC for menu". Restarting with a keypress restarts the same mode immediately.

PAUSE (optional but nice): P key pauses/resumes during play.

CODE QUALITY
- Clean, well-structured JS: a Game state object, functions for reset, step, cpu decision (BFS), draw, input handling, menu handling. Use camelCase for functions and variables. Comments in English.
- Make sure there are no JS errors; the game loop should use setInterval or requestAnimationFrame with a fixed tick timer.

Output must be the complete HTML file content."}
